preregistration_note: The repository-wide search that established the direction of this result was run before this configuration existed, and the direction was already implied by code inspection: no producer in the estate sets the axis fields. What the census adds is the denominator, the slot finding, and a standing refutation. Do not cite it as a preregistered test.
salt_note: There is no generator. Ground truth is what the formats and records actually contain.
question: Who states a witness depth today, and where could one be stated at all?

censuses.slots: For each format in which evidence crosses a boundary: is there a field for witness depth, and is the evidence object closed to additions?
censuses.instances: For each corpus of actual records: how many claim objects state any axis, and how many would earn an admissible depth under canon/ATTESTED-INDEPENDENCE.md?

corpora.note: no claim objects: records experiments, not witnesses. Reported so that zero over zero is not mistaken for a finding.

boundaries: A corpus this programme authored says nothing about adoption by anyone else.
One machine, one estate, one point in time. 52 claim objects is a census, not a rate.
Three of the four corpora were authored here; only the field-evidence corpus derives from a real run, and its sanitisation was done here, so it carries our vocabulary rather than the producer's.
Absence of a stated depth is absence of a statement, not evidence that the witness was shallow. The policy fails closed on it; the census claims nothing more.
Every format measured is one we publish. No external format was examined.
The control-plane ledger is out of scope: its owner-approved columns carry no observer or witness field, so it cannot answer this question either way.
This measures that the policy's input is absent. It does not measure what the policy costs, which is AID-1 and is unrun.
names_next_step: Propose an additive, omit-if-absent depth object for the vendor-neutral authority-evidence contract, so an outside party can state and sign how far its witness went. A contract others implement is not changed here; it is proposed and waits for an owner decision.
refutation: Exhibit one instance, in any corpus, that states a witness depth.
